capability.title: Distribution & Scheduling
capability.summary: Takes cleared creative and gets it out, one channel-neutral PublishRequest per slot, routed to the right adapter and paced by the queue. Adding a channel to the entire estate is one adapter plus one registry entry.

with.note: The subsystem boundary re-checks even though sub.governance just ran. Cheap, and it makes a mis-wired caller fail closed.
The channel field in the request picks the adapter through the policy table. This workflow names no platform.
